findings.summary: The implementation uses `Date.now()` instead of the injected `ClockPort` to generate timestamps, violating time determinism and breaking time-based testability.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the current timestamp from `clock.now()` to `buildRegimePlanRequest` for `asOfUnixMs` (line 107), and use `clock.now()` instead of `Date.now()` when calling `makeClockTimestamp` for `requestedAt` (line 250).
